'''Jacquelien Maria Aleida Scherpen''' is a Dutch applied mathematician specializing in [[nonlinear control]] theory.{{r|csm}} She is a professor in the faculty of science and engineering at the [[University of Groningen]], director of the Groningen Engineering Center, and former scientific director of the Engineering and Technology Institute Groningen (ENTEG).{{r|cv|css}} She has been [[Rector (academia)|rector magnificus]] of the university since September 2023.

==Education and career==
Scherpen was born and raised in [[Schoonebeek]] {{r|lion}}. Subsequently she studied applied mathematics at the [[University of Twente]], earning a master's degree in 1990 and completing her Ph.D. in 1994.{{r|cv|css}} Her doctoral dissertation, '' Balancing for Nonlinear Systems'', was jointly promoted by Huibert Kwakernaak and [[Arjan van der Schaft]].{{r|mg}}

She was affiliated with the [[Delft University of Technology]] from 1994 until 2006, when she moved to her present position at the University of Groningen.{{r|cv|css}} She was scientific director of ENTEG from 2013 to 2019, and has directed the Groningen Engineering Center since 2016.{{r|cv}}

On 1 September 2023 she became [[Rector (academia)|rector magnificus]] of the university, succeeding [[Cisca Wijmenga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rtvnoord.nl/nieuws/1037912/jacquelien-scherpen-nieuwe-rector-magnificus-van-de-rug |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230921054800/https://www.rtvnoord.nl/nieuws/1037912/jacquelien-scherpen-nieuwe-rector-magnificus-van-de-rug |title=Jacquelien Scherpen nieuwe rector magnificus van de RUG |language=nl |publisher=RTV Noord |date=30 June 2023 |archive-date=21 September 2023}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Scherpen was named an [[IEEE Fellow]] in 2021 "for contributions to nonlinear model reduction and passivity-based control".{{r|fi}} She is also a knight of the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion]].{{r|dbn|lion}} In 2022, she was elected Chair of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] Activity Group on Control and Systems Theory (SIAM SIAG/CST).<ref>{{Cite web |title=SIAM Activity Groups Election Results |url=https://sinews.siam.org/Details-Page/siam-activity-groups-election-results-56 |access-date=2022-05-28 |website=SIAM News |language=en-US}}</ref>
